flags: MENU: 12 sections, 107 items, every priced item on the menu their own website publishes (its SkyTab 'Daily' menu, 'All' tab), in their section names and their order (alphabetical, so Beverages comes first; the coordinator may move it last). Nothing left out: no alcohol, no $0 items; gift cards are a separate button, not menu items.

ORDERING PAGE NOT READ: online.skytab.com/s/sugarplumcoffeeshop is JS-only and the browser tool refused that host, so prices are the website's only. Both are fed by the same SkyTab POS, so they should match, but this was not checked.

DESCRIPTIONS shortened from theirs; many of their descriptions are SkyTab's generic filler ('Aromatic tea brewed with a classic tea bag...', 'Crispy golden strips of deliciousness...') and were cut to the facts or left blank. Their '2 Chicken Breast Tenders' description says 'One piece all white breast meat' (copied from the kids' tenders); written as 'All-white breast meat, with French fries'. 'Vanilla & Choc Syrup' ($3.25, Sweeties) kept as they name it, no description: it is not clear what it is.
HOURS agree between their website and Instagram bio ('Open Wed thru Mon 7a - 1:30p, til' 1p on Sun, Closed Tue'): written 'Mon & Wed–Sat 7am–1:30pm, Sun 7am–1pm, closed Tue'.

PHONE (925) 689-1738 is from their Instagram Contact sheet only (Glenn's IMG_7696); their website publishes no phone. EMAIL claudia@sugarplumcoffeeshop.com is on both (the site's is Cloudflare-obfuscated, decoded).

needsSite: NOT set. sugarplumcoffeeshop.com is their own domain with a SkyTab (Shift4) restaurant-site template: their story, menu, gallery, hours and an Order Online button. Same as Norman Rose Tavern's Toast template site (Batch 54), which counted as the site. If the coordinator treats a POS template as a stopgap (the Masa / Adora precedent, where the site was only an ordering app), set needsSite: true; this one is a full site, not just ordering.

BREAKFAST: yes. Sugar Plum is a breakfast-and-lunch diner (their logo says 'Breakfast & Lunch', their bio 'A piece of diner history', open 7am-1:30pm only). Type line 'Breakfast & lunch diner' matches the new Breakfast/Diner category's test (/\bdiners?\b|breakfast|brunch/) and does NOT match BEASTY • Cafe's /coffee|espresso|roaster/, so it lands on Breakfast/Diner by itself and stays off Cafe even though 'Coffee Shop' is in their name (old diner usage; they write that they never took up matcha lattes). If the coordinator wants it on Cafe too, 'Breakfast & lunch diner, coffee shop' would match both.

Coordinator: Glenn wrote "Concord • Eats / BEASTY • Eats" at 8:52 pm, then made the Breakfast/Diner category at 8:56 pm, a few minutes after sending this one, so Sugar Plum is likely the reason for it.
